executedAttempts.route: Official Comune di Verona SIGI service page
executedAttempts.outcome: Success. The page identifies Geoportale SIGI as a public map service for Verona and lists Catasto e urbanistica; it links to http://mappe.comune.verona.it.
Timed out after 20 seconds. No login, CAPTCHA, Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was attempted; this is a viewer usability limitation, not evidence of source absence.

executedAttempts.route: Official Agenzia delle Entrate WMS GetCapabilities
executedAttempts.outcome: Success. The response identifies Cartografia Catastale, layer CP.CadastralParcel / Particelle, queryability, supported CRS including EPSG:6706, and GetFeatureInfo formats text/html, text/plain, and application/vnd.ogc.gml.
Success. Returned one parcel feature with native geometry envelope 10.988886,45.437899 to 10.989622,45.438264 in the response, but no full polygon or attributes.

executedAttempts.route: Same bounded GetFeatureInfo, HTML safe-field response
executedAttempts.outcome: Success. Returned native identity IT.AGE.PLA.L781B016600.361, namespace IT.AGE.PLA., Label 361, and NationalCadastralReference L781B016600.361. No owner, address, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields were requested or retained.
Success but not useful for identity: returned only a generic GetFeatureInfo result and no parcel attributes.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved and used only as the center of a bounded vicinity request; no coordinate was shifted to force a hit.
The bounded response confirms a nearby parcel identity and geometry envelope, not citywide coverage completeness or absence outside the request window.
The official WMS did not return a full polygon in the safe bounded response, so no GeoJSON sample was retained.
The SIGI viewer timeout is not evidence of registry absence; the official Comune page and official national WMS establish the source context.
No unsafe owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields were requested or retained. TLS verification remained enabled and no certificate exception was used.
uncertainty: The WMS InspireId localId is treated as the stable native parcel identity because it was returned by the official service; the underlying database key definition was not separately exposed.
EPSG:6706 axis ordering was followed as returned by the WMS response; the GML envelope is recorded as source evidence only.
Packet completion records research and source qualification evidence only; runtime integration remains held.
